parameters.name: AccessGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the permission group.

parameters.name: AccessRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the permission rule.

parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The type of the file system.

Valid values:

- standard (default): General-purpose NAS.
- extreme: Extreme NAS.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the file system list.

Start value (default value): 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of file systems on each page during a paged query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.
